guidance: At floor11 MAP Ironclad has 76/84 HP, 217 gold, a Strength Potion, Pendulum and newly upgraded Uppercut (13 damage, Weak2, Vulnerable2). Take Monster row11/col2, which leads to a Rest, then a Shop and preboss Rest; avoid the two-Elite branch. In combat prioritize survival over small damage advantages. Use Uppercut early when Weak meaningfully reduces incoming damage, and consider Vicious/Tremble synergy without spending energy on setup when immediate defense is needed. Check all enemy intents, self-damage, retaliation and retained statuses before ending turns. Preserve Strength Potion for boss or meaningful survival/kill threshold, but do not hoard if it prevents substantial loss. Jev should select actual cards and reward from fresh state. Pause for Astra if HP falls to 35 or below.
